task_name: Board panel pickers and dirty-state protection

concerns_addressed: BoardCardTaxonomyFields uses TrackerPropertyPicker and the same workspace loaders as tracker (api.listTrackerVocabularies for priority/label, api.listTrackerProjects) with merge/fallback helpers so selections survive loading/error/empty lists (client/src/components/BoardCardTaxonomyFields.tsx:81-219).

ContextPanel DetailsSection extends baselineRef, dirty detection, save patch, and SSE sync guard to priorityId, labelIds, projectId, and phaseId; cardTaxonomyKey drives server→form sync without clobbering dirty drafts (client/src/components/ContextPanel.tsx:38-235, 256-259).
api.ts saveCard PATCH types extended with taxonomy fields; no statusId anywhere in save path.
BoardContext.tsx (8 lines, not in task file list) mirrors saveCard patch types for TypeScript — required plumbing with no behavioral change; in-scope assessment: acceptable fallout, not scope creep.

Component and ContextPanel tests cover all four pickers, clear-to-null/[], versioned save + baseline adoption, SSE dirty/clean paths, non-destructive list states, and absence of status picker (18/18 passing).

strengths: Reuses TrackerPropertyPicker chrome (NO_PRIORITY, PriorityGlyph, LabelDot, Folder/Signpost icons, inline label picker) consistent with TrackerProperties and TrackerCreateModal.
Dirty/baseline/SSE semantics mirror existing title/assignee pattern — taxonomy folded into baselineRef and dual dirty checks without inventing a board-only picker.
Non-destructive list handling: mergeVocabulary/mergeLabels, synthetic selectedProject from fallback names, listHint for loading/error, conditional show*Picker guards.
Save sends only changed taxonomy fields plus baseline version; successful save updates baseline before clean SSE adoption.
Client tests (BoardCardTaxonomyFields.test.tsx, ContextPanel.test.tsx) and npm run typecheck --workspace=client both green at reviewed SHA.
Conventional commit feat(board-tracker): add board taxonomy panel fields.

issues.description: ContextPanel does not pass projectName/phaseName to BoardCardTaxonomyFields; Card carries only projectId/phaseId so project/phase chip labels may be absent when project lists fail or are empty even though ids remain in draft state (BoardCardTaxonomyFields supports fallbacks but parent does not wire them).
BoardCardTaxonomyFields.tsx is 339 lines — slightly above the ~300-line refactor heuristic though still a focused single component.
BoardContext.tsx patch-type extension is outside the declared task file list but required for client typecheck parity with api.ts; import-only type surface, no runtime delta.
